items.title: Earned weapons, a cosmetic store and a living Plaza
items.summary: Weapons are now earned by levelling your class and equip themselves, and the store sells looks only: seven new cosmetic collections. Breaking natural blocks can reveal a rare cosmetic (0.01% to 0.5%), and the new Collection shows them all.
items.body: Weapons are now earned by levelling your class and equip themselves, and the store sells looks only: seven new cosmetic collections. Breaking natural blocks can reveal a rare cosmetic (0.01% to 0.5%), and the new Collection shows them all. The Plaza has CHOOSE YOUR PATH arrows over the class masters, cherry trees, benches, Mochi the cat and full-body emotes. Dungeon fixes for chests, two-player boss rooms and the dash. A new smooth sound: every weapon type and every class ultimate has its own sound, with soft ambience. Wings now fly by your level, not by rarity.

items.title: A new login screen, and Rootbound is online only
items.summary: Rootbound now opens on an animated login screen with every class on stage. Sign in or create an account to play: progress lives on the server and follows your account, and the progress already on this computer moves into the first account y
items.body: Rootbound now opens on an animated login screen with every class on stage. Sign in or create an account to play: progress lives on the server and follows your account, and the progress already on this computer moves into the first account you make here. New accounts get a recovery key for forgotten passwords. Every key now does one thing: Equipment is on P, the weapon/tool swap on Tab, the wrench on N.

items.title: Evolution cinematics for every class
items.summary: Evolving your class now plays its own 20-second cinematic, starring your character: the Mythic wakes, the new look arrives piece by piece, and the class's signature move ends on the evolution's name. Every class also gets one Mythic with sk
items.body: Evolving your class now plays its own 20-second cinematic, starring your character: the Mythic wakes, the new look arrives piece by piece, and the class's signature move ends on the evolution's name. Every class also gets one Mythic with skills on Q E R Z V, its own sounds and dash, and a brighter anime look.

items.title: Controls work on any keyboard
items.summary: W, A, S, D and every other control now work whichever keyboard language you are using, including Arabic. Typing in chat is unchanged.
items.body: W, A, S, D and every other control now work whichever keyboard language you are using, including Arabic. Typing in chat is unchanged.

items.title: Wings, class weapons and real combat
items.summary: Every class now has its own five weapons, each with its own skills, and Mythic weapons have five skills and a spectacular ultimate. Characters fight with full-body animation and short Japanese battle callouts. Armour now gives stats only; e
items.body: Every class now has its own five weapons, each with its own skills, and Mythic weapons have five skills and a spectacular ultimate. Characters fight with full-body animation and short Japanese battle callouts. Armour now gives stats only; each class has two skills of its own. Wings react to how you really fly, and there are 30 new wings to earn, including the new Relic tier.

items.title: Smoother everywhere
items.summary: Clicks and attacks respond more reliably, even very quick taps. Heavy hits land with more weight. Your character starts and stops walking more smoothly. Menus open faster, and the whole game runs steadier.
items.body: Clicks and attacks respond more reliably, even very quick taps. Heavy hits land with more weight. Your character starts and stops walking more smoothly. Menus open faster, and the whole game runs steadier.

items.title: A living world, and a real phone
items.summary: Rootlink now feels like a real phone: your character takes it out, the screen wakes, and it holds just the quick things you need. Weather and moving skies are back, and pause by themselves if your game slows down. The three lands of the Fir
items.body: Rootlink now feels like a real phone: your character takes it out, the screen wakes, and it holds just the quick things you need. Weather and moving skies are back, and pause by themselves if your game slows down. The three lands of the First Realm now hide 24 discoveries: lore fragments, buried caches, rare finds and chime puzzles. Track everything in Quests > Logbook.

items.title: New trading, and choose how you fight
items.summary: Trading has a new window: two clear boxes, your items below, and a final check before anything changes hands. Weapons, wearables, wings and charms can now be traded. Choosing a class is simpler too: see every class on one page, what it does
items.body: Trading has a new window: two clear boxes, your items below, and a final check before anything changes hands. Weapons, wearables, wings and charms can now be traded. Choosing a class is simpler too: see every class on one page, what it does, how hard it is, and watch it in action. Press K, then All classes.

items.title: Drop anything, and a cleaner character card
items.summary: You can now drop items, weapons, wearables, store wings and charms as real objects in the world, and press E to pick them up. If nobody takes them, they come back to you after 15 minutes. The wrench has a new look and its own panel: press V
items.body: You can now drop items, weapons, wearables, store wings and charms as real objects in the world, and press E to pick them up. If nobody takes them, they come back to you after 15 minutes. The wrench has a new look and its own panel: press V, and R to change mode. Tools are bigger in your hand and explain themselves the first time. Your character card is simpler, and the health bar now moves smoothly.

items.title: The First Realm road, and a new inventory
items.summary: Three new lands await at the World Gate: Sunroot Vale, Gloamglass Reach and the Starfall Wastes. Finish each questline to open the next. Your inventory now slides up from the hotbar: drag the handle, or press I. Every item now tells you whe
items.body: Three new lands await at the World Gate: Sunroot Vale, Gloamglass Reach and the Starfall Wastes. Finish each questline to open the next. Your inventory now slides up from the hotbar: drag the handle, or press I. Every item now tells you where to find it and what it's for. Achievements, Bosses and Collection have moved into Quests.

items.title: The new intro cinematic, and Rootlink on screen
items.summary: The new 92-second cinematic is now the intro every time you start Rootbound. Watch it again any time from Settings > General > Intro film, or from Rootlink. Rootlink, your phone, now has its own button under your character card, next to Res
items.body: The new 92-second cinematic is now the intro every time you start Rootbound. Watch it again any time from Settings > General > Intro film, or from Rootlink. Rootlink, your phone, now has its own button under your character card, next to Respawn (or press M).

items.title: The brand fonts, now built in
items.summary: Rootbound's title and menu fonts now come with the game, so everything looks right even when you start without internet.
items.body: Rootbound's title and menu fonts now come with the game, so everything looks right even when you start without internet.

items.title: A new look, and Weapon Mastery
items.summary: Rootbound has its own logo now, and it greets you right after the intro film. Every panel shares one look: deep-violet glass, gold lines and serif titles. Legendary items shimmer. New: Weapon Mastery. Every defeat counts toward the weapon i
items.body: Rootbound has its own logo now, and it greets you right after the intro film. Every panel shares one look: deep-violet glass, gold lines and serif titles. Legendary items shimmer. New: Weapon Mastery. Every defeat counts toward the weapon in your hand, with five levels and gem rewards, stars on the weapon in your inventory, and a Mastery app on Rootlink (M). Fixed: the worlds you build no longer turn grey and quiet like the story's Silent realms.

items.title: The Worlds We Left Behind
items.summary: The story arrives. Open your Journal (M > Journal) and watch it fill as you explore: every realm you visit, every word you speak at the Word Gate and every guardian you lay to rest writes a new page. The Plaza townsfolk now remember what yo
items.body: The story arrives. Open your Journal (M > Journal) and watch it fill as you explore: every realm you visit, every word you speak at the Word Gate and every guardian you lay to rest writes a new page. The Plaza townsfolk now remember what you've done and talk about it in their own voices, and eight of them have small stories for you. Silent worlds come back to life as you restore them, and when all five are home, the Plaza throws a festival. Some names were also changed: the Hollow Grove, the Nameless Gardener, the Halls of the Eternal Night and the Bloodbound class.

items.title: The official trailer, a phone menu, steadier co-op
items.summary: Two-player dungeons no longer disconnect in long fights: the server stopped counting every busy moment against you, and a small pill by the map shows your connection. Watch the new official trailer in Settings > General > Trailer. Press M f
items.body: Two-player dungeons no longer disconnect in long fights: the server stopped counting every busy moment against you, and a small pill by the map shows your connection. Watch the new official trailer in Settings > General > Trailer. Press M for Rootlink, your phone: your profile, today's challenges and every menu in one place (Shift+M now mutes the music).

items.title: Rootbound 6.13.5
items.summary: Fixes the freezing for players who had Uncapped frame rate switched on: the game now always stays in sync with your monitor (143 FPS on a 144 Hz screen), steady with no stutter. The setting has been removed.
items.body: Fixes the freezing for players who had Uncapped frame rate switched on: the game now always stays in sync with your monitor (143 FPS on a 144 Hz screen), steady with no stutter. The setting has been removed.

items.title: Rootbound 6.13.4
items.summary: Smoother play: fixes the freezes on the intro film, right after loading in, and the short freeze every 10 seconds while playing. Camera zooms in boss fights no longer stutter, and the inventory opens instantly.
items.body: Smoother play: fixes the freezes on the intro film, right after loading in, and the short freeze every 10 seconds while playing. Camera zooms in boss fights no longer stutter, and the inventory opens instantly.

items.title: Rootbound 6.13.3
items.summary: The dungeon bosses now control the weather: storms, blizzards, burning skies, eclipses and corrupted groves that grow as each fight goes on. Every boss has four phases, a final form and voiced lines, and fights smarter. The six legendary bo
items.body: The dungeon bosses now control the weather: storms, blizzards, burning skies, eclipses and corrupted groves that grow as each fight goes on. Every boss has four phases, a final form and voiced lines, and fights smarter. The six legendary bosses have new signature abilities, like leading lightning onto a rod to strike Varkhazan. New settings in Dungeons > Options for bright flashes and slow motion.

items.title: Rootbound 6.13.2
items.summary: Meet Lavi, your fairy guide. New: Combat Power, a weapon forge that upgrades with dungeon materials, items that explain what they're for, dungeon requirements with real drop odds, and "What should I grind next?". The first dungeon now opens
items.body: Meet Lavi, your fairy guide. New: Combat Power, a weapon forge that upgrades with dungeon materials, items that explain what they're for, dungeon requirements with real drop odds, and "What should I grind next?". The first dungeon now opens at level 10. Clearing a dungeon alone now pays gems, and party clears really add theirs.

items.title: Rootbound 6.13.1
items.summary: A small maintenance update.
items.body: A small maintenance update.

items.title: Rootbound 6.13
items.summary: Two-player dungeons, the Soft Glass look, cinematic polish, and the new Rootbound Launcher.
items.body: Two-player dungeons, the Soft Glass look, cinematic polish, and the new Rootbound Launcher.

items.title: Two-player dungeons
items.summary: Two players can now clear any dungeon together, with shared monsters and bosses, revives, puzzle chambers only two can solve, and duo boss mechanics.
items.body:
Two players can now clear any dungeon together.

Parties live on the server. Monsters and bosses are shared, a downed partner can be revived, some puzzle chambers can only be solved by two, and bosses have their own duo mechanics. Rewards are paid by the server, once per account.

items.title: The Soft Glass look
items.summary: A new default look, with settings for blur, particles, shadows, film effects, interface motion and a performance mode.
items.body:
Soft Glass is the new default look, with settings for blur, particles, shadows, film effects, interface motion and a performance mode. Panels scale up on big screens.

Boss deaths now slow down, first clears get their own moment, films you have seen can be replayed and skipped, and several boss entrances have their own camera and effects.

items.title: Ten dungeons, from level 15 to endgame
items.summary: Each dungeon is a private world with its own map, monsters, boss, film and score. Keys and gates, parkour trials, Abyssal difficulty, drops and crafting.
items.body:
Ten new dungeons, from level 15 to endgame. Each is a private world with its own map, monsters, boss, film and score.

Also included: keys and gates, parkour trials, Abyssal difficulty, drops, crafting and rewards.

items.title: Rootbound 6.12: Windows only, and the launch and wings fixes
items.summary: Rootbound is now a Windows game, with the launch bug, the wings crash and the white screen after restarting all fixed. Your saves carry over.
items.body:
Rootbound is now a Windows game. Your saves carry over. Online play, accounts and shared worlds all stay, in the app.

Fixed: the dock going missing when your last world no longer existed, the screen going blank after changing wings in the air, the white look after restarting, sign-ins that quietly ran out, and importing a save.

events.title: Weekly dungeon challenges
events.summary: Three challenges, the same for everyone that week. They change every Monday at 00:00 UTC.
events.reward: Dungeon materials, paid when a challenge is done

events.title: Daily challenges
events.summary: Three new challenges each day, with a streak bonus. They change at midnight on your PC.
events.reward: Gems and XP, with a streak bonus
